item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:00 PM 06 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(SanJacinto, SanFernando, Aroroy, Baleno, Mandaon), #NorthernSamar(Allen, Capul, SanAntonio, SanJose, Victoria, SanIsidro, Bobon, SanVicente), #Romblon(Magdiwang, SanFernando, Cajidiocan, Banton, Corcuera, Concepcion), #Albay(CityOfLigao, PioDuran, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot, Bacacay, RapuRapu, SantoDomingo, Manito, LegazpiCity, Daraga, Camalig, Guinobatan, Jovellar), #Sorsogon(Donsol, Pilar, Castilla), #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes, Basud), #Marinduque(Buenavista, Torrijos and Gasan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, Gubat, PrietoDiaz, Casiguran, Barcelona, Bulusan, Magallanes, Irosin, Juban, Bulan, Matnog, SantaMagdalena), #Masbate(Monreal, Claveria), #NorthernSamar(Lavezares, Biri, Rosario), #Romblon(Romblon, SanAndres, SanAgustin, Calatrava, Odiongan, SantaMaria, Ferrol, Looc, Alcantara, SantaFe and SanJose) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
